items.description: Surge-damaged home electronics (speaker system and TV set), 2 pcs
items.rationale: Overvoltage from atmospheric electricity (2.3.3) is insured, and both appliances were physically damaged. The indemnity is an equivalent standard-grade replacement (7.1.9) of roughly EUR 1,200 for TV and speakers, well under the EUR 5,000 sub-limit. The claim states nothing was on a surge-protected strip, so the 2.3.3 reduction applies and the indemnity is 50%, about EUR 600.

items.description: Diagnostic surge-failure report and technician call-out, 3 pcs
items.rationale: This is a diagnostic and documentation charge plus a wiring safety check. It is not a repair cost under 7.1.8(e) and 7.1.5, and the predominant purpose is not indemnifiable (7.1.10). The call-out is not separately priced, so it cannot be split out under 7.1.8(d). t is most likely 0.
